description:
These patches now also work with [Morphe](https://morphe.software). Each release carries two bundles: `patches-0.4.0.rvp` for ReVanced Manager and the ReVanced CLI, as before, and the new `patches-0.4.0.mpp` for Morphe Manager and the Morphe CLI. Both have the same patches: 12 for rif is fun `5.6.22` and 15 for Sync for Reddit `v23.06.30-13:39`. From now on the two bundles are built from separate code, so a later release may differ between them; each app's page says what its bundle has.

**ReVanced users:** nothing changes. Keep the patches source you have; ReVanced Manager updates from it as before. One fix:

- **Spoof client** (rif is fun): patching no longer fails when you set the **Redirect URI** option to rif's own `redditisfun://auth`, which people often register for their own Reddit app.

**Morphe users:** in Morphe Manager, open **Sources**, tap **+**, paste `https://github.com/edbfi/apk-patches` and tap **Add**. The source's **Signed by** should read `bb0f 2749 5a09 70ea`. With the Morphe CLI, pass `-p https://github.com/edbfi/apk-patches`. To keep the data of an app you patched with ReVanced Manager, import the key it was signed with in Morphe Manager's Settings → **Signing key** first; otherwise Android makes you uninstall it. The [README](https://github.com/edbfi/apk-patches/blob/v0.4.0/README.md#install) has the details and how to verify each download.

Patches for Morphe, all on by default except **Use /user/ endpoint**, as in the ReVanced bundle: the [rif is fun page](https://github.com/edbfi/apk-patches/blob/v0.4.0/docs/morphe/rifisfun.md) and the [Sync for Reddit page](https://github.com/edbfi/apk-patches/blob/v0.4.0/docs/morphe/syncforreddit.md) list them with their options and known issues.

Tested on a device before release: both bundles for both apps, patched with their CLI and with their Manager, installed over the app already there, and each patch checked in the app.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes ads and the ad consent form, and keeps the ad SDKs from starting.

patches.name: Enable golden platinum
patches.description: Enables the golden platinum features that work without rif's servers, and makes the ads setting switch only ads.

patches.name: Fix /s/ links
patches.description: Opens Reddit share links (/s/) as the post they point to, from the app and from other apps.

patches.name: Fix galleries
patches.description: Fixes Reddit galleries and inline Reddit videos failing to load, including gallery images Reddit marks as failed.

patches.name: Fix Imgur
patches.description: Fixes Imgur albums and album thumbnails failing to load, and links with a title in them.

options.description: The Imgur API client ID to load albums with. The default is the app's own.

patches.name: Fix load more comments
patches.description: Fixes "load more comments" not loading further comments.

patches.name: Fix markdown links
patches.description: Shows markdown links that Reddit leaves as raw text, such as links to u/name, as links.

patches.name: Fix media links
patches.description: Opens reddit.com/media links as the Reddit-hosted image they wrap.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs
patches.description: Fixes Redgifs videos not loading.

patches.name: Fix YouTube player
patches.description: Fixes the built-in YouTube player, which showed a black screen and error code 0.

patches.name: Keep typed text in view
patches.description: Keeps the line being typed in view when writing a long reply.

patches.name: Spoof client
patches.description: Restores login and browsing by using another app's Reddit OAuth client.

options.description: The Reddit OAuth client ID of an installed app. The default is RedReader's. Change the redirect URI and User-Agent with it.
The redirect URI registered for the client ID, without characters that need URL encoding.
The User-Agent sent to Reddit: that of the app the client ID belongs to.

patches.description: Removes ads and the ad consent form, and keeps the ad SDKs from starting.

patches.name: Disable Sync for Lemmy bottom sheet
patches.description: Removes the Sync for Lemmy promotion that shows at every start.

patches.name: Enable Sync Ultra
patches.description: Enables the Sync Ultra features that work without Sync's servers, and loads website previews on the device.

patches.description: Opens Reddit share links (/s/) as the post they point to, from the app and from other apps.

patches.description: Fixes Reddit galleries failing to open.

patches.name: Fix Imgur
patches.description: Fixes Imgur albums failing to open, album previews in comments and posts staying blank, and Imgur uploads failing.

options.description: The Imgur API client ID to load albums and upload images with. The default is RedReader's.

patches.name: Fix Other discussions
patches.description: Fixes "Other discussions" failing to load, by searching Reddit for the link instead.

patches.name: Fix post thumbnails
patches.description: Fixes post thumbnails not loading.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs
patches.description: Fixes Redgifs videos not loading, Enhanced autoplay's included.

patches.name: Fix Tenor previews
patches.description: Fixes previews of Tenor links in comments and posts staying blank.

patches.name: Fix video downloads
patches.description: Fixes downloaded Reddit videos having only audio.

patches.name: Fix View more comments
patches.description: Fixes "View more" not loading further comments.

patches.name: Hide Gfycat link previews
patches.description: Hides the blank previews of Gfycat links in comments and posts. Gfycat shut down in 2023.

patches.description: Restores login and browsing by using another app's Reddit OAuth client.

options.description: The Reddit OAuth client ID of an installed app. The default is RedReader's. Change the redirect URI and User-Agent with it.
The redirect URI registered for the client ID, without characters that need URL encoding.
The User-Agent sent to Reddit: that of the app the client ID belongs to.

patches.name: Use /user/ endpoint
patches.description: Requests user profiles from /user/ instead of /u/. Not needed today: Reddit redirects /u/ to /user/, and the app follows the redirect.
